text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew. These dumbbells you gave me are 
incredible. The weight is just right, and 
the grip doesn't slip at all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the wonderful present. 
...This will elevate the quality of my 
training even further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! Please use these dumbbells to get 
even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, are you sure about this? Wouldn't 
this be... right, what they call sending 
salt onigiri to the enemy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you might be right. But there's a 
benefit in it for me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your running, which earned you the title 
of "Monster"―― To me, it's just like a 
heavy set of dumbbells.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to surpass that! Just thinking 
about it makes so much energy well up 
inside me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Heh. Then... to live up to those 
expectations, could I ask for one more 
round of training?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Of course! All right then, let's begin 
Ryan's Hell Workout!
